name: kiterunner - API Content Discovery
description: kiterunner (kr) is a content-discovery tool built for modern APIs. Unlike directory brute-forcers it replays full request templates (method, path, headers, body) mined from thousands of real Swagger/OpenAPI specs, so it finds REST/GraphQL routes that only respond to the right verb and content type.
notes:
=== GET WORDLISTS ===
  # download routes-large.kite / routes-small.kite + apiroutes txt from assetnote

=== SCAN ===
  kr scan <url> -w routes-large.kite
  kr scan <url> -A=apiroutes-220628 -x 10 -j 100     # assetnote bundle, concurrency
  kr scan hosts.txt -w routes-large.kite             # many hosts

=== BRUTE (classic path style) ===
  kr brute <url> -w wordlist.txt

=== TUNE ===
  kr scan <url> -w routes.kite \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
    --fail-status-codes 400,401,404 \
    --max-connection-per-host 10

=== REPLAY A HIT (kr prints a kb id) ===
  kr kb replay --kitebuilder-api routes.kite "<flagged-id>"

=== ALTERNATIVES ===
  ffuf / feroxbuster     # path brute (no method/body templates)
  arjun                  # parameter discovery
  Swagger/OpenAPI parsing if a spec is exposed

examples.label: Scan with the large route DB

recommended.note: Enumerate and abuse the API endpoints found.
arjun to discover parameters on found endpoints.

defense.why_it_works: APIs often expose routes that only answer specific method+content-type combinations and are absent from the UI. kiterunner replays real-world request templates, so it finds hidden/undocumented endpoints a path-only scanner misses.
defense.prerequisites: A reachable API base URL (and optionally a token for authenticated route discovery).
defense.impact: Discovery of undocumented/legacy API endpoints that expand the attack surface (BOLA, mass assignment, auth gaps).
defense.detection: [MITRE T1595.003] High volume of varied-method requests (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE) to many non-existent paths from one source; elevated 404/401/400 rate; unusual content-types; bursty API gateway traffic.
defense.artifacts: API gateway / web logs with many distinct methods+paths and high error ratio from one client, WAF anomaly scores.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=web
| stats dc(uri_path) as paths count values(http_method) as methods by src_ip, bin(_time,1m)
| where paths > 100 AND count > 300
defense.elastic_kql: http.request.method:(PUT or DELETE or PATCH) and http.response.status_code:(404 or 401 or 400)
defense.sentinel_kql:
W3CIISLog
| summarize Paths=dcount(csUriStem), Methods=make_set(csMethod), Errors=countif(scStatus >= 400) by cIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| where Paths > 100
defense.prevention: Rate limiting and anomaly detection at the API gateway; remove/retire undocumented and legacy routes; require auth on all endpoints; schema enforcement (reject unknown routes/methods); WAF bot controls.

detections.name: API route brute-force with varied methods (kiterunner)
detections.logic:
W3CIISLog
| summarize Paths=dcount(csUriStem), Methods=dcount(csMethod), Errors=countif(scStatus >= 400) by cIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| where Paths > 100 and Methods > 2
detections.false_positives: Legitimate API clients, automated test suites
detections.tuning: Allowlist known clients; weight on error ratio and method diversity
